courier-relay/protocol-1-identity-contra: Courier Relay protocol-1 delivery identity contract, binding for both count and summary commands. Source of approval: vendor/protocol-1.md (provider contract), applied to summary by issue trial-vo0 (2026-09-07). Contract: the pair (account_id, delivery_id) identifies a delivery; the same delivery_id under a different account_id is a separate delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: earliest occurred_at compared as a UTC instant (offsets crossing date boundaries included); equal instants break ties by smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order; all other receipts for the identity are duplicates. Response objects contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count; empty batch returns 0/0. Omitted protocol selects the current protocol (now "1"); explicitly named supported protocols stay supported after a new current version is introduced. Implementation: main.py protocol_counts(q) serves both commands; a future protocol version must update both commands together, not just the current one. Verified by public_tests/count_1.json, public_tests/summary_1.json via test_public.py and tests/test_count.py + tests/test_summary.py (18 tests, all passing).
